# Chip group: `jl-chip-group`

A row of chips to choose from: one, as radios, or several, each turned on and off.

- Class `JlChipGroup`, a molecule: `import { JlChipGroup } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/chip-group

A chip group is a row of choices that stays light: filters above a list, the categories of a shop, the
reason for a correction. With one choice it behaves as radios: Tab reaches the chosen chip, the arrow keys move the
choice, and pressing the chosen chip again keeps it. With multiple, each chip turns on and off, the arrow keys move
between them and Space presses.

value is always a list, in the order of the options: one value at most without multiple. HTML may write a single
value as it is (value="open") or a list as JSON. A badge after the label counts what the choice holds.

On a narrow screen the row scrolls sideways rather than pushing the page wider; wrap lets the chips go to the next
line instead. It takes part in forms: one entry with one choice, an entry per value with several, and required
refuses a form while nothing is chosen.

## Use

```ts
import { JlChipGroup } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlChipGroup
  label="Status"
  options={[{"badge":128,"label":"All","value":"all"},{"badge":12,"label":"Open","value":"open"},{"badge":5,"label":"In progress","value":"progress"},{"badge":3,"label":"Waiting","value":"waiting"},{"badge":96,"label":"Done","value":"done"},{"badge":12,"label":"Cancelled","value":"cancelled"}]}
  value={['open']}
/>
```

```html
<jl-chip-group
  label="Status"
  options='[{"badge":128,"label":"All","value":"all"},{"badge":12,"label":"Open","value":"open"},{"badge":5,"label":"In progress","value":"progress"},{"badge":3,"label":"Waiting","value":"waiting"},{"badge":96,"label":"Done","value":"done"},{"badge":12,"label":"Cancelled","value":"cancelled"}]'
  value="open"
></jl-chip-group>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `options` (attribute `options`): `ChipGroupOption<Value>[]`, default `[]`. The choices: value, label, and an optional icon, badge and disabled.
- `value` (attribute `value`): `Value[]`, default `[]`. The chosen values. In HTML, one value as it is or a JSON list.
- `multiple` (attribute `multiple`): `boolean`, default `false`. Several chips can be chosen, each turned on and off.
- `wrap` (attribute `wrap`): `boolean`, default `false`. Goes to the next line instead of scrolling sideways.
- `size` (attribute `size`): `'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'`, default `'md'`. The height: 24, 28 or 36 pixels.
- `label` (attribute `label`): `string`, default `''`. The name of the group for screen readers, when nothing visible names it.
- `required` (attribute `required`): `boolean`, default `false`. A form refuses to submit while nothing is chosen.
- `disabled` (attribute `disabled`): `boolean`, default `false`. No chip can be pressed.
- `name` (attribute `name`): `string`, default `''`. The name of its entries in the form data.

## Events

In JSX, the `on…` prop, its handler given the detail; in code, `events.register(name, (detail) => …)`. They do not bubble.

- `change` (`onChange` in JSX), detail `Value[]`: People changed the choice: the chosen values, in the order of the options.

## Methods

- `focus(options?: FocusOptions): void`: Focuses the chosen chip, or the first one that can be chosen.
- `checkValidity(): boolean`: Whether a required group has a choice.
- `reportValidity(): boolean`: The same check; when it fails, the browser shows its message on the control.

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The row of chips.

## Typing

Typed by its values, JlChipGroup<'open' | 'done' | 'failed'> takes options of those values only, and gives change and value as lists of them: the editor completes them and refuses another. In JSX, the type can also be read from the options.

```ts
import type { JlChipGroup } from '@syware/jlib';

type Status = 'open' | 'done' | 'failed';

const status = document.querySelector<JlChipGroup<Status>>('jl-chip-group.status');
status?.options.set([
  { label: 'Open', value: 'open' },
  { label: 'Done', value: 'done' },
  { label: 'Failed', value: 'failed' },
]);
status?.value.set(['open', 'failed']);
// @ts-expect-error: 'closed' is not a status
status?.value.set(['closed']);
status?.events.register('change', (values) => filterBy(values)); // values: Status[]
```

```tsx
import { Jadis } from '@jadis/core';
import { JlChipGroup } from '@syware/jlib';

import type { ChipGroupOption } from '@syware/jlib';

type Status = 'open' | 'done' | 'failed';

const STATUSES: ChipGroupOption<Status>[] = [
  { label: 'Open', value: 'open' },
  { label: 'Done', value: 'done' },
  { label: 'Failed', value: 'failed' },
];

export class JobFilters extends Jadis {
  static readonly selector = 'job-filters';

  templateHtml(): Node {
    // value={['closed']} does not compile. Without <Status>, the type is read from the options.
    return (
      <JlChipGroup<Status>
        label="Status"
        multiple
        options={STATUSES}
        value={['open']}
        onChange={(values) => filterBy(values)}
      />
    );
  }
}

JobFilters.register();
```

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### Filters

One choice with counts, as filters above a list. The row scrolls sideways when narrow.

```html
<div class="stack">
  <jl-chip-group class="demo-filter" label="Status" value="open" options='[{"badge":128,"label":"All","value":"all"},{"badge":12,"label":"Open","value":"open"},{"badge":5,"label":"In progress","value":"progress"},{"badge":3,"label":"Waiting","value":"waiting"},{"badge":96,"label":"Done","value":"done"},{"badge":12,"label":"Cancelled","value":"cancelled"}]'></jl-chip-group>
  <span class="muted demo-filtered">Showing: open</span>
</div>
```

```js
root.querySelector('.demo-filter').events.register('change', ([status]) => {
  root.querySelector('.demo-filtered').textContent = `Showing: ${status}`;
});
```

### Several choices

Several choices, each with its icon; they wrap to the next line.

```html
<jl-chip-group label="Topics" multiple wrap value='["design","data"]' options='[{"icon":"code","label":"Engineering","value":"engineering"},{"icon":"palette","label":"Design","value":"design"},{"icon":"chart","label":"Data","value":"data"},{"icon":"shield-check","label":"Security","value":"security"},{"icon":"users","label":"People","value":"people"}]'></jl-chip-group>
```

### In a form

Nothing chosen yet, and required in a form; a choice can be disabled.

```html
<form class="stack demo-form">
  <jl-chip-group name="reason" label="Reason" required options='[{"label":"Damaged","value":"damaged"},{"label":"Lost","value":"lost"},{"label":"Found","value":"found"},{"label":"Counted","value":"counted"},{"disabled":true,"label":"Expired","value":"expired"}]'></jl-chip-group>
  <div class="row">
    <jl-button type="submit" variant="primary" label="Save"></jl-button>
    <span class="muted demo-sent"></span>
  </div>
</form>
```

```js
const form = root.querySelector('.demo-form');
form.addEventListener('submit', (event) => {
  event.preventDefault();
  root.querySelector('.demo-sent').textContent = `reason=${new FormData(form).get('reason')}`;
});
```

### Sizes

sm in dense panels, md by default, lg where a thumb presses it.

```html
<div class="stack">
  <jl-chip-group size="sm" label="Period" value="week" options='[{"label":"Day","value":"day"},{"label":"Week","value":"week"},{"label":"Month","value":"month"}]'></jl-chip-group>
  <jl-chip-group label="Period" value="week" options='[{"label":"Day","value":"day"},{"label":"Week","value":"week"},{"label":"Month","value":"month"}]'></jl-chip-group>
  <jl-chip-group size="lg" label="Period" value="week" options='[{"label":"Day","value":"day"},{"label":"Week","value":"week"},{"label":"Month","value":"month"}]'></jl-chip-group>
</div>
```
